scopeLimits: Feature configuration global/local PUT commands only; the existing building read projection is extracted unchanged and reused. Schemas, policies, SQL transition helper and migrations unchanged.

Same advisory lock, optimistic versions, inheritance/dependencies, timestamps and transaction. Upsert is MFA/capability guarded; real row waits and VOLATILE transition returns require fresh checks; audit and NOTIFY are rolled back with the command.

V2 restores the full permission catalog row including created_at; V1 review is separate. All72 new cases use raw HTTP login, enrollment and TOTP for positive proof in the same SID; SQL fixtures supply only data and explicit negative identity/catalog/trigger changes.
Baseline45 expected failures:36 status200 versus403,8 conflict409 versus403,1 local zero-row200 versus500. Every baseline failure requires its exact preceding state/audit/notification diagnostic.

16 actual restricted connection waits on owner advisory or row locks, with pg_stat_clear_snapshot polling and identity removal committed with release. Four late-NOTIFY cases prove rollback cancels queued delivery using a committed listener barrier.
Eight proof-removing triggers and eight exceptions, exact row/proof restoration, sequence witnesses and trigger catalog equality; two skipped inserts reject false success/audit/notification.

Eight positive cases cover flag/global binding, global/local first insertion, disable/reenable/inheritance, exact24-item/eight-field projection, every affected building and dependency, parking invalidation, versions and audit metadata. Additional role refusals, concurrency and validation checks are separate.

Four unchanged regressions:48 TAP,45 independent cases and3 parent groups. Historical read/event fixtures retain explicit synthetic-SQL proof limitations. Full feature lifecycle/ingest suite not run in this batch.
Temporary Windows system activity requests set and cleared for each functional run, with unchanged timeouts and memory guards. No permanent power settings or restart.
Mandatory MFA068 remains candidate; runtime main001-067 unchanged. Other domains, cache, full API/ingest, browser/native Android/iOS, performance, operations and final presentation remain pending.
